content: Hi, this is Mark from Amazon Refund Processing. I noticed something odd with your recent order, so I just wanted to verify a few things with you.
Uh, okay. I'm sorry, I'm in the middle of getting my mom settled, but what's going on with my order?

No worries, I'll keep this brief. There appears to be a delay with your order due to a customs regulation. Before we can continue, could you confirm the full name and address linked to your Amazon account, just to be sure I'm speaking with the right person?
Yeah, it's Lisa Jensen, and the address should be 148 Maple Street, Apt 2B.
Thank you, Lisa. I do see that information on file. Now, the order in question is for a set of kitchen appliances, correct?
Yes, that's right. I ordered a blender and a toaster.

Great, I'm looking at the exact order. The issue is that there's a new policy requiring a temporary customs duty before the shipment can be released. I understand this is unexpected, but it's a compliance thing with Amazon's updated procedures.
I've never had to pay anything extra before. Are you sure? I really need this order delivered soon.

I completely understand your concern, and I want to assure you this fee is only temporary. Once processed, it'll be fully refunded to your original payment method. Amazon just needs proof of payment before releasing the items.
Okay, but how do I pay this? I can't stay on the phone long.

No problem, I'll make it quick. For customs fees, Amazon currently accepts payment via Amazon-approved gift cards or direct crypto transfer. These are the fastest, safest channels to process the refund and release. Which would be easiest for you?
Uh, maybe the gift card? I don't really use crypto.

That works perfectly, Lisa. I can walk you through it. All you'll need is an Amazon gift card in the amount of $180, which matches the customs fee for your items. You can get it at any grocery or drug store.
Okay, but what do I do once I have the card? Is there a special website?

Once you've purchased the gift card, just scratch off the back to reveal the code, then enter the code at the secure Amazon refund portal. I'll send you a link right now. Can you please open your browser and go to www.amazon-refund-support.com?
Alright, let me open my laptop. Hang on, I have to get my charger.
Absolutely, take your time. Once you're at the website, let me know, and I'll guide you step by step. It's very straightforward.
Okay, I'm looking at the site now. It says, 'Enter card code to process refund.'
That's the right page. After you've purchased the gift card, just enter the code there, and the customs duty will be processed instantly. The refund will be scheduled within 24 hours.
So I just buy a $180 card and put the number in here? That's it?
Exactly. If you have any trouble, I'm here to help. And just to confirm, could you provide your best contact number in case I need to follow up on your refund status?
Sure, it's 414-555-0192. Is there anything else I need to do?
That's perfect, thank you. Once you've submitted the code, you'll get a confirmation email from Amazon Refunds. Please check your inbox and spam folder just in case.
Alright, I'll go to the store and get the card as soon as I put my mom down for her nap.
Thank you for your cooperation, Lisa. Remember, this is just a temporary step, and your money will be refunded right after. I'll be here if you need any further assistance.
Okay, thanks for the help. I hope this works out.

You're welcome, and I appreciate your patience. If you have any issues with the online portal, just let me know or call our direct support number. We'll make sure your order gets released without further delay.
Alright. I'll get back to you if there are any problems.
